title: HAZARDOUS MATERIALS
knowledge: State the nurse's role and responsibilities regarding the management, storage and labeling of HAZARDOUS MATERIALS in their area of practice.
Explain the rationale for the fact that all healthcare providers and waste handlers must have up-to-date hepatitis immunizations.
Identify all HAZARDOUS medical waste requiring special disposal in area of practice.
Explain rationale for obtaining appropriate HAZARDOUS medical waste disposal containers in area of practice.
Discuss segregating HAZARDOUS medical waste based on specific type and appropriate disposal of same as relevant to area of practice.
Discuss the process for ordering, transporting, receiving and storage of all HAZARDOUS MATERIALS appropriate to area of practice.
Refer to the appropriate Safety Data Sheet (SDS) document for proper disposal of each specific type of HAZARDOUS waste as relevant to area of practice.
Describe the meaning of the different classification of risk and be able to differentiate between the HAZARDOUS levels using the colors and numbers used to identify chemicals/materials.
Explain the role and responsibilities of other personnel coming into area of practice regarding HAZARDOUS MATERIALS.
skills: Identify the HAZARDOUS MATERIALS in area of practice.
Locate manufacturer's Safety Data Sheets (SDS) folder.
Obtain and use personal protective equipment (PPE) before disposing of HAZARDOUS medical waste.
Put on PPE appropriate to anticipated exposure in area of practice.
Dispose of infectious material waste based on specific type.
Demonstrate how to properly manage a spill of a HAZARDOUS MATERIAL in area of practice.
Completes documentation to record HAZARD identified and the correct disposal of same.
attitude: Show a belief that the environment created in the area of practice and the hospital as a whole, can affect the SAFETY for healthcare providers, patients and relatives and has a direct impact on the quality of care given in the area of practice.
Actively promote SAFETY in area of practice and with specific regard to HAZARDOUS MATERIALS.
Self-aware to limitation in knowledge and skills.

Demonstrate ability to organize and facilitate a Reflection session in and on practice after a HAZARDOUS MATERIAL learning opportunity occurs and activate findings to improve future practice and response.
